description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named SystemUIModes that demonstrates various ways to modify system UI visibility and window attributes, including immersive modes, translucency, and action modes. It includes nested classes, UI controls, and event handling for UI customization.

classes.name: SystemUIModes
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating system UI visibility and window attribute modifications, with nested class IV for custom ImageView handling UI visibility changes.

classes.name: SystemUIModes.IV
classes.description: Custom ImageView subclass that implements system UI visibility change listener and manages action modes.

methods.name: setFullscreen
methods.description: Enables or disables fullscreen mode by setting window flags.

methods.name: setOverscan
methods.description: Enables or disables overscan area in window attributes.

methods.name: setTranslucentStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables translucent status bar.

methods.name: setTranslucentNavigation
methods.description: Enables or disables translucent navigation bar.

methods.name: getDisplaySize
methods.description: Returns a string with display metrics dimensions.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns a string with the size and position of the image view.

methods.name: refreshSizes
methods.description: Updates the UI with current display and view sizes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI controls, and event listeners.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu, sets up search and share intents.

methods.name: onAttachedToWindow
methods.description: Updates check controls when activity window is attached.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles search query text change events.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles search query submission, shows a toast.

methods.name: updateCheckControls
methods.description: Syncs checkbox states with current system UI visibility flags.

methods.name: updateSystemUi
methods.description: Applies UI visibility flags based on checkbox states.

methods.name: clearActionMode
methods.description: Resets the action mode checkbox state.
